notes_for_editor: Dates agree across sources: erected 1966 (Forest Lookouts), standing June 1999 (trip report), removed 2015 (Forest Lookouts). The Division of Forestry link rests on the NPS form's table, which lists Millsfield in Dyer County; the table is not dated per tower, so the agency fact is medium confidence. No staffing, fire or access information in any source read. Record photo is from easternuslookouts and is already in the record, so no new photo is listed. Tnlandforms gives 515 ft (the record holds 157 m). The NPS form notes that many of the division's towers were removed or are awaiting demolition after disuse or expired leases; that general point is not applied to Millsfield in the story.
